hotspots.title: AfD party congress protests
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right AfD holds its federal party congress in Erfurt amid massive protests, with up to 50,000 demonstrators expected. Police deploy thousands of officers to manage potential clashes, while AfD leaders Weidel and Chrupalla seek re-election.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-stakes confrontation between far-right politics and anti-fascist opposition, symbolizing broader European tensions over extremism and democracy.

hotspots.title: PP-Vox coalition in Andalusia
hotspots.blurb: Spain's conservative PP and far-right Vox finalize a coalition agreement to govern Andalusia, granting Vox significant influence over key portfolios like Justice and Tourism. The deal includes controversial policies such as 'national priority' for public services and the elimination of Arabic language classes.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the normalization of far-right policies in a major Spanish region, sparking fears of democratic backsliding and societal polarization.

hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-stakes impact on French politics, the far-right's future, and the broader European political landscape, with intense moral and legal framing.

hotspots.title: Tisza party surge in Hungary

hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its potential to disrupt Hungary's political landscape, with high affective investment in anti-corruption narratives, moral panic over democratic backsliding, and intense polarization.
